content: The Mine Safety and Health Act of 1977, also known as the Federal Mine Safety and Health Act of 1977 (Public Law 95-164), was a legislative amendment to the Coal Mine Safety and Health Act of 1969. This law is codified in the United States Code under Title 30, which pertains to Mineral Lands and Mining, specifically in Chapter 22, addressing Mine Safety and Health. The Act was officially enacted on November 9, 1977, and its provisions became effective 120 days after its enactment date.
